title: Day 1 seeing if I can Build a profitable bot with AI
author: Foreign-Ad-8689
selftext: Hi I know how to Trade(im no professional tho) but I kinda want to try out new things so I just bought Cursor pro and I’m trying to build a AI I have no experience in coding so this is probably gonna take a while. So if yall got tips ill gladly take em, btw trying to build a “quant” bot(if  you could say that) yeah peace✌️

comments.author: Sure_Ant7939
comments.body: Good luck in your journey. At the end only resilience matters in stuffs like this. No matter the advice you get at this point the most important thing that will guarantee any kind of success is how many times you are ready to test and re-test.

comments.author: adiabramov
comments.body: it is a steep learning curve for sure. dont let the initial drawdown in your backtests discourage you, most retail strategies fail because they lack proper risk managment. welcome to the grind.

comments.author: misterRegime
comments.body:
One tip that costs nothing now and can't be added later: log every setup your bot sees and doesn't take, with what the price did afterwards. Nobody keeps that file and it's the only way to tell later whether your filter does anything.

Do it before you go live, not after. It can't be reconstructed.
